evidence.computation: Uses typical material density for mass, volume and flotation comparisons.
assumptions: A material and requested operation establish the domain even when the necessary amount is missing.
Density rows model typical material states; phase and name narrowing remain enforced by the native recognizer.
untrusted: English interpretation and JSON framing; these contexts describe domains, not proof of an individual interpretation.

evidence.computation: Hooke force, extension, stiffness, elastic energy and ideal mass-spring period/frequency.
assumptions: A missing stiffness, displacement, force or mass does not remove a spring request from its domain.
Ideal linear spring model; required magnitudes and domain guards remain in the native consumer.
untrusted: English interpretation and JSON framing; these contexts describe domains, not proof of an individual interpretation.

evidence.computation: Fuel energy, required mass and carbon emissions from standard default fuel values.
assumptions: The requested fuel operation establishes domain even without a fuel mass.
Default net calorific and emission factors; not a model of moisture, boiler efficiency or lifecycle emissions.
untrusted: English interpretation and JSON framing; these contexts describe domains, not proof of an individual interpretation.

evidence.computation: Converts a stated signed temperature difference by exact scale ratio, with no affine offset.
assumptions: One stated temperature difference, with source and target temperature scales.
Multiple endpoints are not interpreted as a single scalar difference.
untrusted: English operation and unit recognition; the typed request and arithmetic response are checked by Quantity.
